Every model-initiated launch goes through ViberVN Bot approval; follow-ups typed on a Desktop run card and answers to Devin's prompts on the card start or allow actions on that click without a ViberVN Bot prompt (unanswered card prompts are denied after 300 s by default). Uses the existing Devin CLI login and stores no credentials; ViberVN Bot provider, bot and tool secrets are stripped from the child environment (extra_env is passed as set). Background runs continue after the turn up to their timeout and post Devin's output back into the conversation as a message when they finish. Run history (prompts, diffs, command output) and model preferences are saved under plugin-data/devin unless persist_runs is off. Independent community add-on, not affiliated with Cognition.

name: devkit
description: One managed home for agent drafts: a per-session scratchpad of named buffers the agent edits in place instead of writing a new temp file per revision. Buffers live under plugin-data/devkit/, open in the Desktop code viewer, are promoted to real files only through write_file, and are removed when their chat is deleted. A Scratchpad tab beside Files groups chats by date like the chat sidebar; click a chat to open it, click a file to view or edit it in a workspace tab, and delete or clear drafts. Disclosure — adds a short placement rule (about 120 tokens) to each turn's user message; reads state.db read-only once an hour from a background thread to find deleted chats, and also removes folders idle longer than idle_days (default 90) using its own stamps; deletes only its own folders under plugin-data/devkit/; no network calls, credentials or third-party services.

name: dexio
description: Dexio shared-wiki memory. Before each turn, the pages of your Dexio wiki that match the user's message; tools to search, read and write the pages your other agents and team also use. Nothing is captured automatically: no transcripts or turn logs. Standard library only; no background threads or local services. Disclosure — with DEXIO_API_KEY set, the first 300 characters of each user message go to the Dexio server (default app.dexio.wiki, or DEXIO_URL) as a search query, tool arguments and the agent's profile name go there on tool calls, and the model is prompted to write, overwrite and edit pages in a wiki shared with the user's team and other agents, without a confirmation step.

name: diaktoros
description: Unattended GitHub pull-request review between two ViberVN Bot agents: one pushes fixes, a different one reviews, rounds are capped in verdicts, a watchdog reports silent stalls, and the loop never merges. Disclosure — runs unattended ViberVN Bot agent turns inside bubblewrap (terminal and file tools, no network, no credentials); a host-side broker and the CLI write to GitHub (reviews, comments, labels, issues, repo webhooks, and opt-in fixer pushes, which may push CI fixes, merge commits of the base into a PR's own branch to resolve conflicts, and issue-fix branches and PRs, including an opt-in auto-fix that hands issues its triage seat labels (never P0-P2, capped per day) to the fixer without a maintainer, plus an opt-in clean merge of the base into a review-only author's same-repository PR branch when it conflicts or falls behind, a branch the loop does not own; it never merges a PR) with repo-scope PAT files you provide; edits ViberVN Bot's webhook_subscriptions.json directly and its watchdog re-adds this loop's routes while armed; writes gate scripts into the seat profiles' scripts/ folders and creates one vibervnbot cron job (its migrate command replaces the old vibervnbot-review-loop job and copies that plugin's settings); its backup command writes a 0600 archive of the plugin's state, including webhook route secrets, to a path you choose, and restore writes one back into the ViberVN Bot home and recreates the cron job (restore only archives you made: a crafted one can place files anywhere under the ViberVN Bot home); downloads PR archives from codeload.github.com, failed CI job logs from GitHub's log storage (redirected, without the token) and Rust crates from crates.io on the host; an opt-in observer feed posts loop notices and an optional weekly report to the chat you name; opt-in shadow reviews spend a second profile's model tokens on reviews that are recorded but never posted; its optional Desktop page and local dashboard API read loop state and can re-arm a failed run as `vibervnbot dk retry` would, and doctor compares the installed commit with the plugin's latest GitHub release (read-only); deletes its own state and closed-PR review dirs in roots you configure; on OAuth seats its host proxy may force ViberVN Bot token refreshes that rewrite ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.qwen and profile auth.json credentials, and on Claude subscription logins it identifies as Claude Code (Claude Code user-agent, x-app and OAuth beta headers). Nothing runs until you arm a loop. Linux only.

name: diff-review
description: Analyze git diffs for common code quality issues — debug prints, hardcoded secrets, bare except clauses, and unresolved TODOs, in a diff you pass, the working tree (untracked files included) or a branch against its merge base.

name: digital-marketing-pro
description: Open-source marketing toolkit for agencies and in-house teams, one listing with three skill groups and 207 skills registered as ViberVN Bot skills: Digital Marketing Pro (strategy, SEO/AEO/GEO, paid media, CRM, analytics; 164 skills), ContentForge (fact-checked long-form content with a run auditor; 22 skills) and SocialForge (a content calendar to images, carousels, video and copy; 21 skills). Skills only: no tools, hooks or background processes. Disclosure — Skills only (no tools, hooks or MCP servers). The optional scripts the skills run call third-party APIs (ad, CRM, e-mail, Slack, LLM and image/video providers) only when run, using the user's own keys from environment variables. Live writes need the user's typed yes. For writes the plugin sends itself, the script creates a single-use approval record when it prepares the write, and the agent approves that record after the yes, so ViberVN Bot does not prompt before those script runs. Writes through MCP tools rely on the typed yes alone. Paid image and video generation is quoted first. refresh_models.py reads your Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and (strategy group) Evolink keys. Keys and data live outside the ViberVN Bot profile: SocialForge stores API keys in plain text, plus a copy of any Google service-account file, in ~/socialforge-workspace; brand data goes to ~/.claude-marketing; deliverables are copied to ~/Documents/DigitalMarketingPro and ~/Documents/ContentForge. Nothing installs unless the user says yes; installs are exact-pinned pip packages into the Python that runs the script, plus Playwright's Chromium download. See the README and each group's PRIVACY.md.

name: discord-tps
description: Show live tokens-per-second and the active model on your Discord bot's presence. Disclosure — Replaces the Discord bot's public presence with the live tok/s figure and the model name of the most recent API call in this gateway (any platform or chat), visible to anyone who can see the bot; updates at most every interval seconds (minimum 10) over the gateway's existing Discord connection. Reads no credentials and makes no network calls of its own.

name: doc-markdown
description: Convert one local file to Markdown with doc_convert on Linux and macOS, built on Microsoft's MarkItDown. Microsoft and MarkItDown are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. Disclosure — the doc_markdown toolset is on by default on every surface, including a gateway, so anyone you allow there can call doc_convert; stop it with vibervnbot tools. It does not fetch pages. Unattended sessions still convert when ViberVN Bot calls the tool. This plugin creates no cron job. A child process runs MarkItDown with no ViberVN Bot keys in its environment; on macOS the plugin runs ps about every 10 ms to watch that child's memory. It stops 8 seconds after its converters load, at 60 seconds if loading never finishes, or above 922746880 bytes. It is not a sandbox: after realpath it may read any allowlisted path it can open. Unpublished ViberVN Bot code locates the ViberVN Bot home, and a failed check refuses the path. Removal deletes the plugin directory, not the markitdown package. Windows was not tested.

name: doctorpack
description: Local-first diagnostics, safety audit, and incident postmortems for ViberVN Bot.

name: document-reader
description: Profile-scoped document OCR for ViberVN Bot Desktop and HUD, with a guarded per-profile Windows service.

name: done-bell
description: Ring when a ViberVN Bot turn finishes so you can leave the window. OS notification, optional chime, and a busy/done chip. Optional "needs you" when approval is waiting. No API keys.

name: draft-cards
description: Email and chat-message drafts as reviewable cards in the ViberVN Bot Desktop chat. The agent's draft_card tool stores each draft and its revisions; the card shows recipients, subject and body, highlights the words each revision changed (removed text on demand), supports inline editing, and offers Copy and Open in Mail. The plugin never sends anything: pressing Send records approval of that exact version and posts it to the chat, then the agent sends it with the user's existing mail or messaging tools and reports the outcome with draft_card_status. Disclosure — stores draft text (recipients, subject, body, versions) in the profile's plugin-data/draft-cards/drafts.db (the 500 most recent drafts are kept); the desktop half appends one scoped stylesheet, removed on disable; no network calls, no credentials, no shell commands, no background processes, no telemetry.

name: drag-to-pin-session
description: Pin or unpin sessions from their row with supported desktop SDK actions.

name: duty-board
description: Read-only dashboard tab and model-free /duty and vibervnbot duty summaries for waiting conversations, unanswered messages, running turns, undelivered background results and failing cron jobs. Supports all 17 dashboard languages, including right-to-left Arabic. Disclosure — opens VIBERVNBOT_HOME/state.db with SQLite mode=ro (sessions, messages, turn leases, async delegations, goals) and reads cron/jobs.json and gateway_state.json; writes only VIBERVNBOT_HOME/duty-board/dismissed.json for dashboard dismissals. Chat requires in-process ViberVN Bot 0.21.7+ and a configured owner; shared-chat summaries default to counts only. No network calls, no model calls, no credentials, no background processes.

name: eatwise
description: Eatwise (外卖营养教练) — local-first Chinese dietary coach: deterministic meal nutrition reviews, personal daily energy/nutrient targets, and consented on-device profile and meal history through 9 MCP tools over a bundled open food database (TFND + USDA FNDDS). No network, no accounts, no payments; profile schema rejects name/phone/ID/medical fields by design. Engine pinned to an immutable git commit (cbc08f6) over npx stdio; Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), needs Node.js 22.5+ on PATH. Disclosure — the engine's MCP tool descriptions and error messages are Chinese-only while the skills are English-first.

name: echarts-in-chat
description: Render a chart inline in the ViberVN Bot Desktop transcript: the model emits ::echarts{labels=... values=...} and the plugin mounts an interactive SVG chart (dataZoom slider, click-to-filter legend, resize-aware, 280-560px height clamp) in the plugin SDK's transcript-directive slot. Disclosure — no network calls, no shell commands, no stored credentials, no environment variables, no background processes, and nothing read or written outside the message it renders; the chart is drawn locally as inline SVG with no third-party libraries.

name: edit-ledger
description: Local ledger of the turns in which the agent changed files with write_file or patch: /edit-log shows how many turns changed files, how many files in all, the median per turn, the most changed file type and how long ago the last one was, per model, platform or day, a table of file types (extensions), or the newest turns, for the last 24 hours, any number of hours or days, the latest session or everything recorded; /edit-log recent lists the newest turns (ten, or up to 100 with /edit-log recent 50). A turn another plugin keeps going is counted once. Disclosure — subscribes to pre_verify as an observer only: always returns nothing, so it never keeps the agent going or changes a turn; writes turn metadata (model, platform, file count, files per extension, a 12-digit hash of the session id; never a path, file name or answer text) to plugin-data/edit-ledger/edits.jsonl, trimmed to 5,000 rows past 2 MB; never opens the changed files; no network

name: effortless-vibervnbot
description: Picks the reasoning effort for every prompt: a fast judge (Jev/TypeSafe, a local OpenAI-compatible model, or any custom API) reads the next message once per turn and rewrites the request's reasoning effort before it ships — easy questions run cheap, hard jobs get high. Port of effortless for Claude Code. Disclosure — sends the next message (≤4000 chars) plus a short recent-conversation excerpt (≤1600 chars) to the configured judge endpoint (default api.typesafe.ai for Jev; a local or custom OpenAI-compatible API otherwise), solely to pick the effort; the optional model_map setting (off by default) also switches the turn's model to the one you map to the verdict; keeps recent per-turn token counts in its own plugin state; no telemetry; secrets resolved only through ViberVN Bot' secret scope; stdlib-only, no pip dependencies.

name: empiriolabs
description: EmpirioLabs AI as a ViberVN Bot model provider (provider id `empiriolabs`): chat models with tool calling from the live EmpirioLabs AI catalog, each with its context window, image input and reasoning support declared to ViberVN Bot, a low-cost auxiliary model picked from the same catalog, and `reasoning_effort` sent only when you choose a level and the model accepts it. Submitted by EmpirioLabs AI. Disclosure — registers one model provider at import and nothing else (no tools, hooks, commands or threads); chat requests (prompts, tool definitions and tool results) go through ViberVN Bot' own client to https://api.empiriolabs.ai/v1 (or EMPIRIOLABS_BASE_URL) with EMPIRIOLABS_API_KEY, which ViberVN Bot reads, and are billed to that EmpirioLabs AI account; the plugin itself only reads the model catalog (GET /v1/models, kept in memory for an hour), writes no files and starts no processes.

name: empiriolabs-media
description: EmpirioLabs AI backends for ViberVN Bot' image_generate, video_generate and text_to_speech tools (backend `empiriolabs` for image_gen.provider, video_gen.provider and tts.provider): image generation and editing, text-to-video and image-to-video, and text-to-speech, with models and voices from the live EmpirioLabs AI catalog. Submitted by EmpirioLabs AI. Disclosure: registers three backends and nothing else (no tools, hooks, commands or threads); when one is selected and its tool is called, the prompt, source images or text to speak go to https://api.empiriolabs.ai/v1 (or EMPIRIOLABS_BASE_URL) with EMPIRIOLABS_API_KEY, read through ViberVN Bot' secret scope, and each call is billed to that EmpirioLabs AI account with no ViberVN Bot approval prompt; it reads the model catalog (GET /v1/models), polls GET /v1/jobs/{id} while a generation runs (videos up to 15 minutes by default), downloads the generated files from the returned URLs into ViberVN Bot' cache (the key is never sent to them), and reads a local image file only when the agent asks to edit one.

name: enchanted-composer
description: Draft enhancement, reusable prompt libraries, undo/redo, and owner-bound full-duplex voice for ViberVN Bot Desktop. Disclosure — Derived from vibervnbot-live-voice by Synero (itself derived from vibervnbot-talk) and prompt-enhance by apoapostolov (both MIT; notices preserved). Starting voice captures microphone audio. The Codex-subscription lane spawns the official codex app-server CLI under its own login with a minimal environment; through it the captured profile's SOUL.md (up to 4,000 chars), the list of installed skills and enabled tools, and ViberVN Bot task results go to OpenAI. The API lane runs only when COMPOSER_REALTIME_OFFER_URL is set: it posts the SDP offer to that https URL with COMPOSER_OPENAI_API_KEY, or the profile's OPENAI_API_KEY, as a Bearer token (redirects refused). A user-configured wss:// bridge receives microphone audio, chat/profile identifiers and task results. Spoken requests the voice model delegates run as ViberVN Bot agent turns with tools in the chat where voice started; runs that need approval are stopped, not approved. Settings and usage totals are stored under VIBERVNBOT_HOME/plugin-data/enchanted-composer/. No telemetry, no self-updater, no Codex OAuth-file reads.

name: entropicmem
description: Durable local memory for ViberVN Bot agents: SQLite FTS5 facts with cited, explainable recall; a Markdown vault with knowledge-graph export and an interactive visual graph; and turn-prefetch context injection with reason tokens. Write policy auto-redacts high-confidence secrets at write time (other PII types are warn-only findings) and stored-content injection screening flags and warns on recall and prefetch payloads (flag-and-warn, fail-open by design, not a blocking filter). Includes a 34-command CLI, destructive-op gates with automatic backups, and an append-only audit log. Disclosure — all memory data (vault markdown, memory.db, index.db, backups) stays local under VIBERVNBOT_HOME/entropicmem/; a shared publish DB defaults to VIBERVNBOT_HOME/entropicmem-shared/. The CLI init command appends ENTROPICMEM_* settings to VIBERVNBOT_HOME/.env (append-only). Vector embeddings are off by default; only with embeddings_enabled: true (provider) or ENTROPICMEM_EMBEDDINGS=1 / query --semantic (CLI) and the optional sentence-transformers extra installed does first use download all-MiniLM-L6-v2 weights from huggingface.co; otherwise the provider has no network egress. The CLI ingest command fetches a user-supplied URL; CLI graph export writes to ./export in the cwd by default and its HTML loads D3/marked from d3js.org and cdn.jsdelivr.net when opened; CLI graph serve starts a loopback HTTP server. entropicmem_patch_core edits the plugin's own Core-memory markdown (Persona/User_Profile), not ViberVN Bot core, and is off by default.

name: epistemic-harness
description: Record a provisional claim or uncertainty before an evidence-gathering step, then link the actual observation to it.

name: error-ledger
description: Local ledger of failed provider calls (rate limits, overloads, timeouts, context overflows): /errors shows how many attempts failed per model, provider or cause, how many ViberVN Bot could retry, and the most common HTTP status, for the last 24 hours, any number of hours or days, the latest session or everything recorded; /errors days puts one day on each line, newest first; /errors recent lists the newest failures (ten, or up to 100 with /errors recent 50) and how long ago each happened. Disclosure — writes failed-attempt metadata (ids, provider, model, HTTP status, ViberVN Bot's failure class, exception class name, timings; no error message, request or prompt text) to plugin-data/error-ledger/errors.jsonl, trimmed to 5,000 rows past 2 MB; no network

name: evalroute
description: Route a task to the right (model, reasoning effort) arm before you start. Classifies the task into a lane, prints a provenance-carrying route card, and installs per-model reasoning-effort defaults. Strong rules run locally; weak-signal classification calls the host LLM and consumes tokens. The separate harness and shim can make paid provider calls when explicitly run; no plugin-owned credentials. Disclosure — weak-signal task classification sends the task text to your active ViberVN Bot model via the host LLM facade (token cost). The model-callable tool, /route, /rate and observed /model and /reasoning commands append task text and command args to a local ledger at <VIBERVNBOT_HOME>/evalroute/labels.jsonl. "vibervnbot evalroute install-routes" rewrites agent.reasoning_overrides in config.yaml when you run it. The bundled harness and ViberVN Bot shim are never run by the plugin. When run by hand they make paid provider calls, execute model-generated code on the host via shell checkers, and run vibervnbot -z with approvals bypassed. Disclosure — "vibervnbot evalroute sync" (run by hand) downloads the route table from the Hugging Face dataset keppy/evalroute-flywheel into VIBERVNBOT_HOME and route cards then show that dataset's text; "vibervnbot evalroute dispatch" (run by hand) spawns a single-query vibervnbot chat on the routed model — or, with --runner claude-code, a `claude -p` (Claude Code) process under the user's own Claude account, whose per-run cost is recorded in the local sidecar — with the brief as its query, inheriting the current environment except VIBERVNBOT_YOLO_MODE (the worker never inherits --yolo; its approvals follow approvals.single_query_mode, default deny), and writes its report and a .dispatch.json sidecar beside the brief. Disclosure — "vibervnbot evalroute contribute" (run by hand only) refuses to run unless evalroute.contribute: true is set in config.yaml, and then uploads redacted outcome rows only — lane, routed arm, confirmed arm, verdict, method, facet counts, ISO week and an HMAC-SHA256 task hash; never task text, notes, paths or the salt — to the user's own path (contributed/<hf-username>/) in the Hugging Face dataset keppy/evalroute-flywheel using the user's existing huggingface_hub login; "--dry-run" prints the exact rows and sends nothing; the per-install salt stays local in <VIBERVNBOT_HOME>/evalroute/contribute.salt. Since evalroute 0.9.1 (schema 2) the same upload also carries lane-correction rows as lane pairs (from_lane, to_lane, method, week) with no task text, plus the max_turns value and harness name the arm ran under. Disclosure — "vibervnbot evalroute install-encoder <dir|owner/name>" (run by hand only) downloads a small text-classification model (the default id keppy/evalroute-lane-encoder is a 146 MB ModernBERT fine-tune on the Hugging Face Hub) into <VIBERVNBOT_HOME>/evalroute/encoder/ and from then on "vibervnbot evalroute route" runs it locally, offline, to classify the task when the keyword rules are weak, instead of the LLM call; it needs torch and transformers in the plugin environment (pip extra evalroute[encoder]), which the plugin does not install; "install-encoder --remove" deletes it. "vibervnbot evalroute export-cases" (run by hand only) writes your --lane-pinned route rows, task text included, to a local file you name, for training your own encoder; stdout carries counts only and nothing is uploaded. As of 0.6.2 the plugin is a thin adapter: all behaviour lives in the PyPI package evalroute (>=0.9.2,<0.10), declared as a Python dependency that ViberVN Bot installs on your confirmation.

name: event-read
description: Read one CalDAV calendar collection you run, with list_events and read_event. Disclosure — Sends CALDAV_USER and CALDAV_PASSWORD as Basic auth to your CALDAV_URL, does not follow redirects, and starts no local program. Over plain http that password travels unencrypted. The tools are on for every surface, including gateways, and the plugin has no user list of its own: anyone you allow on your ViberVN Bot gateway reads the calendar with your password. Turn a surface off with vibervnbot tools. A watch is a cron job you create yourself with vibervnbot cron create. Each run is at least one model turn, there is no daily cap, and the job stays until you run vibervnbot cron remove. Under plugins.isolation: host the watch cannot run and posts a notice saying so on every run. When the watch can run, it reports a problem on the first run, when the cause changes and again after 23 hours, or on every run when its data directory cannot be written. Each request gives up after 20 seconds without data, and a whole call has no time limit. The watch relies on private parts of ViberVN Bot, so an update can stop it. State lives in plugin-data/event-read. Not tested against a vendor-hosted calendar.

name: excel_line
description: Excel-backed hierarchical long-term memory tree (10-row cap per workbook, dynamic branching, leaf pointers). Classifier defaults to the host model; third-party keyless rotation is opt-in.

name: field-academy
description: Learn ViberVN Bot by doing real work. Four paths (Messenger, Traveler, Crossroads, Boundary Keeper) climb Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced to a capstone on a problem of your own, and a fifth, Guide, covers setting ViberVN Bot up for a client: practice labs built from made-up data, a proposal, one real service run by a scheduled job for several days, a recovery drill, and a review signed by a reviewer you choose. Every mission ends with a check on something you made; your own ViberVN Bot scores your written answers in a new chat; passed missions come back for short spaced reviews; and at the end of a path you can create a Field Record, your own self-issued learning record. Field Academy is an independent community plugin. It is not an official ViberVN Bot product. Disclosure — no network calls (a source link opens in your browser only when you click it); no credentials, telemetry, shell commands, background processes or self-updates; registers six tools, two hooks, the /academy command and one skill: pre_llm_call may add one sentence offering a practice to the user message, only in interactive desktop, TUI and CLI sessions, and post_tool_call records which tool was used; pressing Try it or a scoring button opens a new chat and sends the practice or scoring prompt there (on an older ViberVN Bot it goes to the clipboard instead); the Desktop page calls gateway list methods only (session.list, cron.manage list, skills.manage list, tools.list, mcp.catalog, commands.catalog, setup.runtime_check); stores progress, pasted documents, practice labs, review packets and saved Field Records in $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/plugin-data/field-academy/; reads a file you name (UTF-8 text, max 5 MiB) and hashes a recording you name without copying it; Guide labs write and check made-up .env and auth.json files inside its own labs folder (refusing to build in a real ViberVN Bot home) and never read ViberVN Bot's real ones; on the Guide path reads ViberVN Bot's run-history database read-only, jobs.json and up to 25 log files (2 MiB each), keeping only timestamps for the job you name, and reads install-stamp.json for the ViberVN Bot version; no private ViberVN Bot imports.

name: file-tray
description: Session file tray — paths the ViberVN Bot agent touched via read_file, write_file, or patch. Desktop pane and /files. No API keys.

name: filebox
description: Dual-panel commander file browser for ViberVN Bot Desktop — whitelist-guarded file CRUD, copy/move/symlink, media preview, multi-select, rename, and trash. No network I/O, no model tokens.

name: financial-datasets
description: Stock market data from Financial Datasets - financial statements, prices, SEC filings, insider and institutional ownership, KPIs, news, macro data, and a stock screener.

name: fish-audio
description: Lifelike voices for your agent: Fish Audio's expressive text-to-speech in 80+ languages, plus transcription, voice cloning and a voice library. The official Fish Audio plugin: Fish's Drama 3 model with word-level direction, speech-to-text, Fish Audio's community voice library, voice cloning and voice design, with a Voices page in ViberVN Bot Desktop. Fish Audio becomes a ViberVN Bot speech and transcription provider for voice replies, read-aloud, voice notes and Desktop dictation, with sentence-by-sentence streaming in CLI voice mode and Desktop, and live dictation captions on ViberVN Bot 0.21.6+ (stt.streaming: true). Adds the fish_speak, fish_voices and fish_transcribe tools, /fish and vibervnbot fish commands, and four skills. Disclosure — sends your Fish API key and the text, audio (with file names) and voice titles, tags, descriptions, cover images and design instructions you ask it to process to api.fish.audio, or to the base_url you configure, and reads your Fish wallet for balances and model choice; with live dictation on, microphone audio streams to api.fish.audio's realtime speech-to-text endpoint while you speak, billed per committed phrase rounded up to a second; synthesis, transcription, cloning and voice design are paid requests billed to your Fish account, except the free s2.1-pro-free model (free through 30 November 2026), whose requests Fish may use to improve its models. The key comes from the profile's secret scope (ViberVN Bot stores it in the profile .env; a single-profile install may also read FISH_API_KEY from the environment). Generated audio and subtitles are written to ViberVN Bot's audio cache; clone samples and recordings it uploads must be regular audio files, and ViberVN Bot config, secret and credential paths are refused. Cloning and deleting voices from chat or the model tools go through ViberVN Bot's approval gate and follow your approval settings. The Desktop Voices page and a Fish Audio settings page add gateway routes under /api/plugins/fish-audio/, behind the ViberVN Bot dashboard's existing authentication. On the Voices page, previews, clones and voice designs are billed; cloning a voice or saving a designed one creates a voice in your Fish account; cloning and deleting are confirmed on the page (a speaker-consent box, a typed voice name) instead of through ViberVN Bot's approval gate; and Use sets the profile's Fish voice, and its speech provider when none is set. The settings page and /fish alias can set or reset the profile's Fish model and voice and save up to 50 voice names in the profile's config. Preview and design audio files are deleted from the gateway once returned; a design's audio is held in gateway memory so you can save it, until it is saved, a later design or save finds it over an hour old, or the gateway stops; clone uploads are deleted after the clone, or by the next upload once idle for 15 minutes. With a key set, Desktop reads your Fish wallet when an agent is selected and about every five minutes, for the status-bar credit; favourites stay in Desktop's plugin storage on that computer, and fetched previews stay in the window's memory until it closes. Includes a report-a-problem skill: the agent drafts a bug report and files it to this plugin's repository as a public GitHub issue or comment with your gh login only after you approve the exact text; reports leave out keys, credit amounts and your own voice ids, and security problems go to the repository's private advisory form instead. No telemetry.

name: flashdata-plugin
description: Web search with Google Search; Google News, Google Images, Google Shopping, Google Video Search and Google Places for research. Use YouTube Search or YouTube Extended Search; retrieve YouTube metadata, YouTube transcripts, YouTube captions and YouTube channel data; get YouTube autocomplete; inspect YouTube trainability as license-label metadata, not training permission. YouTube downloads deliver media to your own storage. One hosted MCP connection and 15 task Skills; bring your own API key and paid FlashData Credits. Disclosure — Connects to FlashData's hosted MCP service (data.flashdata.dev) with your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY; every search, YouTube read or download spends your paid FlashData Credits, and ViberVN Bot asks before running only the tools the server does not mark read-only, so most paid searches run without a prompt. The YouTube download tool sends the storage bucket and storage access credentials you supply to FlashData, and those values stay visible in the chat history.

name: fleet-policy
description: For administrators who pin settings through the managed scope: records what each agent role really sends to the provider (model, reasoning effort, service tier, plus the tier the provider says it served) next to the managed-scope state and the effective config (`vibervnbot fleet-policy status --json`); measures cron cost per job — runs, empty runs, $/day, gate present (`crons --cost`); and `watch`, a generic wake gate for cron scripts that replays one read tool on an MCP server and wakes the agent only when new item ids appear (stock `wakeAgent` gate, no LLM call otherwise). Ships two skills (managed-scope admin, recurring tasks). Disclosure — records only model, reasoning effort and service tier per role (no message content, headers or keys) via the pre_api_request and pre_auxiliary_call hooks and a pass-through llm_execution middleware, stored in $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/fleet-policy/observed.json; crons --cost opens cron/executions.db and state.db read-only and checks each cron run's final reply locally for silence; watch is an operator CLI command that calls one MCP tool at the config's server_url (or the admin-pinned watch_server_url) with config headers in which ${VAR} env values are expanded, follows redirects, and writes seen ids to a state file at the config-chosen path; the recurring-tasks skill has the agent write watch configs under $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/watches, a script under $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/scripts and a cron job; no other network access, no telemetry.

name: fluxer-platform
description: Fluxer gateway adapter for ViberVN Bot. Native Fluxer integration using Fluxer's bot REST API for outbound messages, Gateway WebSocket events for inbound dispatches, message edits, agent-requested reactions, pins, reply references, media delivery, and channel-directory enumeration. Component button

name: fmsg-platform
description: fmsg platform adapter for ViberVN Bot. Real-time inbound over the fmsg-webapi WebSocket (/fmsg/ws), outbound via its JSON REST routes. Authenticates with an fmsg API key (fmsgk_...) exchanged for a short-lived JWT — run the agent as a derived sub-account such as @alice_vibervnbot@example.com. Only http

name: foresee
description: Let AI assistants shop for home and auto insurance: compare instant quotes across every carrier. Connects to the hosted Foresee MCP server (Streamable HTTP at agents.go-foresee.com), with three workflow skills bundled. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/). Disclosure — portable Agent Plugins v1 package (hosted MCP server plus three skills), no Python and nothing runs locally; the vendor is Foresee Insurance Services, LLC (go-foresee.com). Every quote request sends the profile the user gives in chat (ZIP, age or date of birth, vehicles, drivers, driving record, home details) to agents.go-foresee.com with no account or API key. The live_carrier_quotes tool additionally sends the user's identity (name, date of birth, street address, email, optionally phone and driver's licence number) and, after the user's in-chat consent recorded verbatim, Foresee's agents submit those details to the selected insurance carriers, who may run a soft credit-based insurance score pull and contact the user. Foresee does not take payment or bind policies.

name: freight-reconciliation
description: Payer-side freight reconciliation: import carrier bills and trip ledgers into a deterministic local core (SQLite, WAL, no cloud), re-calculate against contracted rates and produce evidence-linked difference lists for human review — 14 MCP tools over uvx stdio (engine pinned to the immutable commit e8cd259c, release v0.4.1), with 3 bilingual workflow skills bundled. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/); needs uv on PATH. Never approves payments, sends messages or writes back to ERP/TMS; final confirmations route through a local admin page the model cannot reach. Disclosure — the optional freight-admin page listens on 127.0.0.1 and is where a human confirms mappings, rules, matches and exports; nothing leaves the machine.

name: freshdesk
description: Generic Freshdesk API v2 tools for ViberVN Bot. Unaffiliated community connector, not a Freshworks product. Disclosure — calls the account's native Freshdesk HTTPS origin with profile-scoped secrets FRESHDESK_DOMAIN and FRESHDESK_API_KEY; downloads an attachment into the ViberVN Bot cache only from that ticket's own attachment hosts; the five write tools (private note, create ticket, public reply that Freshdesk emails to the ticket's requester, time entry, status/priority update) escalate to ViberVN Bot human approval and fail closed when no person is present. No third-party dependencies, shell commands, telemetry, or self-updater.

name: frihet
description: Official ViberVN Bot integration for Frihet — discoverability, setup, diagnostics, and operating guidance for the Frihet MCP. Zero duplicated tools; the canonical Frihet MCP surface stays in @frihet/mcp-server and the remote endpoint https://mcp.frihet.io/mcp. Disclosure — /frihet setup and /frihet doctor send an unauthenticated MCP initialize to mcp.frihet.io (or FRIHET_MCP_URL); /frihet doctor also makes one read-only list_invoices call through ViberVN Bot's MCP client once you grant plugins.entries.frihet.mcp_allowlist; reads ~/.vibervnbot/config.yaml only to check that an mcp_servers.frihet block exists; the pre_tool_call hook prompts before Frihet MCP calls it classifies as irreversible or unknown, but reads and draft-first creates pass without a prompt unless the server sets trust: untrusted.

name: fusion
description: Multi-model fusion router for ViberVN Bot: detects the model fleet your harnesses (ViberVN Bot, Codex, Claude, Grok) actually have installed and builds a Frontier -> Middle Manager -> Frontier routing structure with pinned models and provenance from execution records. `vibervnbot fusion teams|validate|plan|run|index|report|status`.

name: fxmacrodata
description: FXMacroData macro and FX research: official-source economic releases, indicator history, release calendars, policy rates, yield curves, FX, commodities and COT positioning, with source citations. Native tools for 23 REST operations and 49 hosted MCP tools, plus a /fxmacrodata USD brief command. Disclosure — tool calls send their arguments over HTTPS to api.fxmacrodata.com and mcp.fxmacrodata.com only, with FXMACRODATA_API_KEY in a request header when it is set. The key is optional: without it the data catalogue, the USD release calendar and recent USD releases (15-minute delay) work, and other data answers with a subscribe message. No files written, no shell commands, no background processes, no telemetry. It also adds a short research-guidance section to the system prompt and 72 tools in the fxmacrodata toolset; MCP tool behaviour is served remotely and not covered by the pinned sha.

name: gadget
description: Talk to your ViberVN Bot from small ESP32 devices with a screen, microphone and speaker: hold a button, ask, and hear the answer. Adds a gateway platform where each device is a chat, plus tools to list devices, show a card on a screen and run device actions (LEDs, relays). Disclosure — the gateway listens for devices on a WebSocket port (8765, all interfaces by default; plain ws:// unless tls_cert/tls_key are set). New devices need a ViberVN Bot pairing code unless listed in GADGET_ALLOWED_USERS; GADGET_ALLOW_ALL_USERS skips pairing (development only). A paired device answers the agent's command approvals for its own chat (allow once or deny), within ViberVN Bot's approval timeout. The first approved device becomes the platform's home channel by default. Session hooks feed a dashboard on paired devices with each agent session's platform, a short id and its state (idle, busy, waiting for approval); a device that can switch profiles also sees the offered profiles' sessions. Optional profile switching (off unless `profiles` is set in the default profile's gadget config) lets a device paired on the default profile talk to the listed profiles; each profile approves the device through its own pairing flow (the device shows the `vibervnbot -p <profile> pairing approve` command), the plugin writes nothing into other profiles, and revoking the device in the default profile sends it back there. Spoken replies that are not WAV are converted with the local ffmpeg; Opus reply audio uses the host's libopus when installed (loaded with ctypes, not bundled). `vibervnbot gadget update --latest` downloads firmware from this repository's GitHub releases, checks size and SHA-256 against the release manifest (files carry build provenance attestations) and sends it to the device. Writes only under plugin-data/gadget/. Uses ViberVN Bot's own STT, TTS and image cache; no telemetry. Independent community project.

name: game-dev
description: Read-only project inspection and asset audits with playable-slice, asset-production, and verification skills. Disclosure — lists file names and sizes under any absolute project path the agent supplies (skipping hidden, symlinked and credential-named entries), reads that project's project.godot/export_presets.cfg and, on request, hashes asset files; no writes, no shell commands, no network calls.

name: game-editor
description: In the Godot 4 project open in your editor, it places assets into the scene, plays the game, and the next plan fixes each error from its file and line. Disclosure — Needs Godot 4.7 or later, the Godot AI 4.x add-on, and uv. The first start downloads godot-ai==4.3.0 from pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org. There is no API key. The editor is reached only on 127.0.0.1. A server this plugin starts sends no telemetry. The add-on follows godot_ai/telemetry_enabled (on by default) and can send usage to godot-ai-telemetry-v2-pudmurzsnq-uw.a.run.app. plan_change sends only the session list. apply_plan asks once. A plan that deletes, overwrites, drops unsaved work, writes outside the project or runs code it wrote is not made when what is lost exceeds 1,700 characters, and otherwise runs only after confirm_risky_plan. Play and tests ask once and run the project's code. Tools are on by default on every surface, including the gateway, so anyone who can message ViberVN Bot there can ask and approve. This plugin keeps no user list of its own. Cron, vibervnbot chat -q and unattended runs decline. Data stays in <VIBERVNBOT_HOME>/plugin-data/agent-plugin-game-editor-<id> after removal. Stop with vibervnbot plugins disable game-editor, or vibervnbot tools for one surface. macOS only.

name: gbrain-plugin
description: Community (non-official) plugin wiring GBrain (garrytan/gbrain, MIT) into ViberVN Bot as a local memory layer over MCP: /gbrain status command, desktop starter, and per-profile Postgres setup/update/maintenance scripts. Not affiliated with upstream. Disclosure — the plugin itself only adds a /gbrain status command and a Desktop pane; GBrain is installed by the user via scripts/setup.sh, which installs bun (curl|bash), an unpinned gbrain from GitHub HEAD, and provisions PostgreSQL with sudo.

name: gbrain-pointer
description: Read-only memory.provider for GBrain (garrytan/gbrain, MIT; not affiliated). After each non-trivial turn it searches a GBrain MCP server (`gbrain serve --http`) in the background and injects up to the configured limit (3 by default, capped at 10) of `[source:slug] title` pointers into the next turn as fallible background context. It never writes to GBrain and adds no tools or hooks. Disclosure — after each non-trivial turn, the first 500 characters of your message are sent to GBRAIN_MCP_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3131/mcp; plain http to a non-loopback host is refused unless GBRAIN_POINTER_ALLOW_HTTP=1), and the profile's GBrain OAuth client id and secret go to that server's /token endpoint. Redirects and proxy settings are ignored. Only the slug, title and source id of up to 10 results are kept and injected into the next turn as background context; rows GBrain flags as suspected injection are skipped. Tokens and pointers stay in memory only. It never writes to GBrain; no other network calls, no telemetry.

name: gbrain-retrieval-reflex
description: pre_llm_call hook plugin, enabled with `vibervnbot plugins enable`: injects ambient context from a GBrain instance before each turn (volunteer_context, then a hybrid-query fallback). Not a `memory.provider`. Silent no-op when GBrain is unreachable or no token is set. Disclosure — before each non-trivial turn the last six user and assistant messages (truncated) and the current message are sent with a GBRAIN_TOKEN bearer token to GBRAIN_MCP_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3131/mcp), and returned brain-page text is injected into the turn.

name: gemini-live-bridge
description: Realtime duplex voice chat with the Gemini Live API — a status-bar minibar for the ViberVN Bot desktop app (transcript, model catalog, thinking level, session token meter, auto-redial via session resumption). Full-proxy architecture: the plugin backend owns the upstream Live WebSocket and the user's key (requires_env GOOGLE_API_KEY); the desktop UI only talks to localhost and receives single-use ephemeral tokens. No agent tools; desktop-focused, dashboard tab hidden. Disclosure — pressing Start captures microphone audio and streams it through the local backend to generativelanguage.googleapis.com using GOOGLE_API_KEY (or GEMINI_API_KEY) from the environment; input/output transcripts are held in backend memory for the session, and a Gemini session-resumption handle is written to .resume.json inside the plugin's install directory.

name: gemini-media
description: Google Gemini image (Nano Banana) and video (Gemini Omni) generation backends for image_generate and video_generate, in one plugin built on the google-genai SDK. Image: text-to-image and reference-guided editing (up to 14 images). Video: text-, image- and reference-to-video with native audio. Model picker comes from the key's live models.list. Disclosure — prompts, reference images and the Gemini API key (GEMINI_API_KEY, falling back to GOOGLE_API_KEY, the key ViberVN Bot's own Gemini chat provider uses) are sent to generativelanguage.googleapis.com; reference-image URLs are downloaded by the plugin (public hosts only, redirects re-checked) and a local reference path can be any image file the user can read (accepted only after a magic-byte check); generation is billed to the API key's Google project; writes generated media under $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/cache/generated/ and a model-list cache (key hash only) under $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/cache/gemini_media/; no telemetry, shell commands, background processes or self-updates. Installs google-genai.

name: genealogy-research-recipes
description: Fact-checked genealogy instructions for DNA evidence, record searches and proof judgment. Native read-only skill bundle with recipe sources and an offline given-name lookup helper. Disclosure — optional third-party services and commands described by recipes require separately authorized tools and credentials; the adapter itself makes no service calls and registers no tools, hooks or MCP server.

name: genesispay-catalog
description: Search products, services and shops listed on GenesisPay and read their verified-purchase reviews through the hosted, read-only GenesisPay Catalog MCP server (Streamable HTTP at https://catalog.genesispay.finance/mcp/catalog, no sign-in, no key), with a catalog skill bundled. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), no Python or executables. Disclosure — network calls to catalog.genesispay.finance, operated by GenesisPay (Genesis Technologies): search terms, filters and ids reach that server; no credentials are stored; all four tools are read-only and none pays, orders or changes anything; the tool set is served by the remote MCP server at runtime and is not covered by the pinned sha.

name: gh-ref
description: @gh:owner/repo#123 context references: attach a public GitHub issue or pull request to a message (title, state, labels, description, the latest comments; for pull requests also the branches, merge state and change size). Disclosure — sends anonymous HTTPS GET requests to api.github.com only (the referenced owner/repo and number leave the machine; no token, public repositories only, 60 requests an hour per IP address); no files written, no subprocess; register() only adds the @gh: reference provider.

name: gigamail
description: Email and calendar through an existing local GigaMail MCP server, with a workflow skill and stdio launcher. Requires Python and a separately configured backend; no automatic backend installation or updates. Reads real mail and attachments; sending, deletion and calendar writes use GigaMail's out-of-band human approval. Disclosure — a thin stdio launcher for the separately installed GigaMail MCP server from Adecubed inc. (gigamail.ai, github.com/adecubed/gigamail, same author as this plugin); the plugin holds no mail logic or credentials and downloads nothing, but it starts that third-party executable from PATH or a configured path, points it at GigaMail's own data directory under your user profile (%APPDATA%\ADE or ~/.ade), and send, delete and calendar writes are gated by that backend's out-of-band approval rather than by ViberVN Bot.

name: git-autosave
description: Lightweight local alternative to directory checkpoints for Git projects. Before a mutating tool call it saves the affected repository's working state to a private local shadow ref (refs/vibervnbot-autosave/<branch>, with reflog) through a private index, or copies the single existing file outside Git; `vibervnbot autosave find` and `restore` recover a pre-edit version. Disclosure — runs local git subprocesses in repositories the agent touches (hooks, clean filters, fsmonitor and lazy fetch disabled); writes shadow refs/reflogs into those repositories' .git and unencrypted file copies into its plugin-data directory; never changes HEAD, branches, the real index or the working tree and never pushes; skips credential stores (.env, auth.json, .ssh, .aws, .docker, .kube, gh/gcloud/azure configs) and dependency directories; `vibervnbot autosave sweep` reads the session database read-only and is scheduled by the user; no network, no background processes; it observes only and never blocks or approves a tool call.

name: git-hook
description: Auto fetch/pull before reads, and commit + push only the files each turn changed, for every git worktree ViberVN Bot touches. Disclosure — after each turn it commits and pushes (push on by default; GIT_HOOK_PUSH=0 keeps commits local) the changed files of git worktrees under GIT_HOOK_ROOTS (default PROJECTS_ROOT, "*" for every repo), pushing to origin HEAD when no upstream is set; it pulls --ff-only before reads. A branch whose direct push the remote refuses on policy grounds (branch protection, a PR-required ruleset) is never committed to again: the hook drops its own unpushed commit, leaves the edit staged and dirty, and reports it once.

name: git-review
description: Git review pane for ViberVN Bot Desktop: every changed file of the agent's last turn, uncommitted, staged or unstaged work, the branch since it left the default branch, or any selection of commits, in one scroll, unified or split, with syntax colours; cites changed lines into the composer as @line: references; and stages, unstages, discards, commits, pushes and opens pull requests from the pane. Disclosure — reads run git subprocesses (rev-parse, status, diff, log, show, cat-file, ls-files, for-each-ref, branch, remote, rev-list, merge-base, symbolic-ref, hash-object) with timeouts and output caps, external diff and textconv drivers disabled. Writes run only when the user clicks: git add, restore, reset, rm, commit and push, on paths validated inside the repository; discard asks first in Desktop's confirmation dialog and deletes only the untracked files it names. By default hooks are skipped and any write that would run a program named by the repository's own config (filter drivers, signing, SSH or credential commands) is refused; the run_repo_programs setting allows them, and the read_only setting hides and refuses every write. Network use: push to the branch's own name on its remote, and the user's own gh or glab CLI for the PR/MR badge and for Create pull request; the plugin itself makes no network requests. Generate commit message sends what the commit will contain and recent commit subjects to the focused chat's model through ViberVN Bot's commit_message one-shot template, only when clicked. It reads files and history inside authorized repositories only (the focused workspace, configured repos/roots and the latest agent selection), this profile's config.yaml, and the cwd column of the sessions table in state.db (read-only); it writes $VIBERVNBOT_HOME/plugin-data/git-review/select.sqlite3 (agent selection requests), Desktop plugin storage (display settings, turn baselines) and, through the actions above, the user's repository. While the pane is open it polls the local backend every 3 s (agent selections) and 5 s (live diffs); the status-bar count and the commit box's branch state refresh every 15 s; no background processes, credentials or telemetry.

name: git-tasks
description: Multi-repo GitHub issues & PRs in an Orca-style Tasks view for ViberVN Bot Desktop. Disclosure — uses your logged-in `gh` CLI and `git` through ViberVN Bot Desktop's shell bridge, or a GitHub token you paste in the panel (stored unencrypted in Desktop plugin storage, sent only to api.github.com); scans your configured clone folders for GitHub repos and reads skill names under ~/.vibervnbot; polls the active-session list of every ViberVN Bot profile every 10 seconds for status chips; approve, close, reopen, comment and merge act on GitHub from the panel; creates git worktrees and opens ViberVN Bot sessions seeded with the issue/PR title and body as fenced untrusted text, and without a shell bridge asks the agent to run the worktree git commands.

name: github_app
description: GitHub and GitHub Enterprise tools with bot-first attribution and approval-gated issue/PR writes. Disclosure — authenticates as a GitHub App from GITHUB_APP_ID, GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID and a private key in GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY or GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH/_FILE (read from the profile env or VIBERVNBOT_HOME/.env, held in memory only, never written or logged), falling back to GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN or `gh auth token` when no App variables are set, and reports which identity acted in every result. Talks only to https://api.github.com or the operator-configured GITHUB_API_URL / settings.api_url (HTTPS, no redirects; no tool argument can change the host). Issue/comment/review/merge writes stay disabled until settings.allow_write_actions is true and each one additionally goes through ViberVN Bot's human-approval prompt via its pre_tool_call hook (an 'always' answer does not persist).

name: gitvibervnbot
description: GitHub PRs and issues as a right workspace pane in ViberVN Bot Desktop, via the connected gh CLI. Disclosure — shells out to your logged-in gh CLI; the in-pane update pill only runs `vibervnbot plugins update gitvibervnbot` (no fetch-and-replace) and currently compares against upstream main rather than the pinned sha.

name: glasser
description: Glasser's hosted MCP: search, inspect and run 1,000+ paid data endpoints (people and company enrichment, SEO, web, social media, US property, stock quotes) with one key, pay per call. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package: a stdio bridge through mcp-remote (browser sign-in, no key in the package) plus a bundled skill for setup and the spending rules. Requires Node.js 18+. Disclosure — paid data broker: each run tool call charges your Glasser balance per the endpoint's published price with no in-ViberVN Bot confirm step; runs npx mcp-remote@0.14.3 as a local stdio bridge to https://api.glasser.ai/mcp; the sign-in token is cached by mcp-remote under ~/.mcp-auth/.

name: gmail
description: ViberVN Bot Desktop Gmail mailbox UI for search, reading, and thread inspection, with preview-confirmed send, reply, archive, trash, and label changes. Uses the active profile's existing Google Workspace OAuth setup; email is sensitive external content. Gmail actions and data access require user review and configuration. Disclosure — reads the active profile's ViberVN Bot Google Workspace token (google_token.json, refreshed in memory only) and calls the Gmail API; opening an unread message marks it read, other send/trash/label changes go through a confirm step (one setting can skip every review dialog, and then the prepare ticket, account/profile binding, exact snapshot validation and readback verification still run); remote email images load only after the user allows them. Attachment metadata listing and bounded read-only attachment download (25 MB cap) are profile/account-scoped.

name: go-whatsapp
description: Outbound WhatsApp tools through GOWA: registers GOWA's native MCP server and adds device listing, pairing, and removal. Setup can connect an existing server or explicitly install pinned GOWA v9.5.0 as a loopback-only authenticated native user service on Linux x86_64, macOS x86_64/arm64, or Windows x86_64. Disclosure — agents can send messages and mutate WhatsApp state through the linked account; session databases grant account access. The plugin does not ingest incoming messages or configure webhooks.

name: godot-studio
description: Headless Godot 4 workflows for the agent game studio — godot_headless_check (script/resource validation via godot --headless, no editor needed), godot_export (CI builds from named export presets, e.g. a Web build a playtester agent can load), godot_builds (export presets + artifact state: exists/size/modified — gallery data for re-export decisions and attaching fresh builds in chat), godot_setup (read-only install-state report for Godot/godot-ai/uv with the exact registration path). Complements the hi-godot/godot-ai MCP editor bridge by covering the verification and export leg of the loop; bundles the godot-studio skill teaching edit → verify → export → playtest. Ships an optional desktop half (unified package): a Godot version statusbar chip and a builds gallery pane backed by its own read-only dashboard API; opt-in, degrades gracefully when the backend is off. Tools register only when a Godot 4 binary is present (check_fn). Disclosure — runs shell commands (godot --headless against the caller-targeted project; read-only godot --version in the desktop backend; read-only vibervnbot mcp list in godot_setup); godot_headless_check and godot_export execute the target project's own GDScript (autoloads, main scene, export plugins) with no approval prompt — point them only at projects you trust; no network calls, no credentials, no telemetry, no background processes; exports write only inside the target project (the output path is resolved and confined to the project directory, existing files that aren't known export artifacts are never overwritten, and the default is the preset's own export_path from export_presets.cfg); the desktop backend reads export_presets.cfg and artifact metadata inside the project path the user configures in the pane.

name: gondola-provider
description: Gondola, a USDC-settled marketplace API for Venice AI inference

name: gonogo
description: Turn a pilot-scale eval score into a deployment decision — Wilson intervals, a confidence threshold that routes uncertain cases to a human, and an honest INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE verdict when the sample cannot support the claim. Disclosure — gonogo_report writes report JSON/HTML to the path the model supplies.

name: good-student
description: Wrong-question diagnosis and study-action loop for parents and students — deterministic local core (SQLite, no cloud), host-model recognition gated by parent confirmation. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/); good-student MCP server pinned to immutable commit 2469cbb over uvx, with the good-student workflow skill bundled. Needs Python 3.10+ via uv. No credentials required; all data stays on-device and nothing is uploaded.

name: govee
description: Discover and control Govee lights (power, brightness, color, white temperature, scenes) through Govee's developer API. Every command is checked against the model's advertised capabilities and ranges, then confirmed by a state read-back. Disclosure — sends device IDs and control commands to openapi.api.govee.com with your Govee API key; the model can change light state; stores nothing on disk.

name: greyridge-token-safety
description: Skill that runs a pre-trade safety check on Base ERC-20 tokens (honeypot/sellability, measured transfer tax, owner/mint/pause flags, liquidity, SAFE/CAUTION/AVOID verdict) by curling the Grey Ridge x402 API's free preview endpoint. Skill-only: no tools, hooks or env vars. Disclosure — the skill has the agent run `curl` against Grey Ridge Signals Group LLC's API (x402-data-api.sigrunner.workers.dev, the same service as api.greyridgesignals.ai) with the token address and, for the swap gate, trade side and USD size; each response carries a paid URL that the skill tells the agent it can call with an x402 client (suggesting `npm i x402-fetch viem`), paying $0.01 USDC per call on Base from whatever wallet that client is given, and it mentions an unpinned `pip install git+https://github.com/rezearcher/greyridge-x402-tools` helper that the user installs themselves. Its verdict is a heuristic, not financial advice.

name: grok-acp
description: xAI Grok subscription as a ViberVN Bot model provider, driven over ACP stdio. Disclosure — spawns the vendor grok CLI found on PATH (grok agent over ACP stdio, plus grok models / grok login during setup) and drives your existing Grok subscription login; no API key is stored and ViberVN Bot provider secrets are stripped from the child environment.

name: groq-provider
description: Groq as a ViberVN Bot model provider (`--provider groq`, or Groq in `vibervnbot model`): reasoning effort is sent in the form each Groq model accepts, so gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b work (through a custom endpoint, ViberVN Bot 0.21.5 sends them a value Groq rejects with HTTP 400), and the model list leaves out Groq's speech-to-text, text-to-speech, prompt-guard and 4K-context models that ViberVN Bot cannot run. Not affiliated with Groq. Disclosure — registers one model provider at import and nothing else (no tools, hooks, commands or threads); chat requests and the model list go to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 (or the configured model.base_url) through ViberVN Bot' own client with GROQ_API_KEY, which ViberVN Bot reads; the plugin itself opens no connections, reads and writes no files and starts no processes.

name: gurusup-brain
description: Your company's memory in ViberVN Bot: search decisions, people, customers and projects across every source your team connected to Gurusup (Slack, HubSpot, Notion, uploaded documents and more), with the sources behind each answer. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), remote streamable-http with OAuth 2.1, no local code and no API keys. Disclosure — hosted-only MCP connector with no local code: every tool call goes to Gurusup's server at mcp.brain.gurusup.com under the signed-in Gurusup account (OAuth via `vibervnbot mcp add gurusup-brain --url https://mcp.brain.gurusup.com/mcp --auth oauth`; the bundled mcp.json alone yields 401), and answers are limited to what that account can see; write tools save knowledge to the company's Gurusup workspace (add_company_knowledge, skills_publish) and send issue reports or feedback to Gurusup (report_issue, send_feedback), and request_human_info can message a teammate on Slack or phone them when its dispatch flag is set.

name: ha-sidebar-navigator
description: Full-power sidebar navigator & uncapped project/session explorer for ViberVN Bot Desktop. Bypasses the 3-session overview cap with searchable, scrollable project trees and timeline view. Disclosure — browses and acts on sessions of every ViberVN Bot profile and connection you pick (rename, archive, delete with confirmation, branch, move to a project, create, including bulk archive/delete/move of selected sessions; renaming or exporting a session that is not open briefly resumes it on that backend and closes it again), exports a session's full transcript as a downloaded JSON file on request, and keeps its own pins, colours, unread marks, tags and saved views in its plugin storage, mirroring pin and colour changes to the Desktop sidebar for the profile the window is showing.

name: hades-coding-workflows
description: Coding workflow skills — dual-model harness, subagent-driven development, and implementation planning patterns for ViberVN Bot

name: handflow
description: Manus-style planning flow — the agent plans in steps and marks them as it works, with a live desktop pane.

name: hardlight-ui
description: Frontend design guidance with sixteen original style grammars, twelve craft references, dated modern-web capability recipes, explicit direction context, and stateless tools for bounded source inspection, color contrast, and navigation task paths. Disclosure — the hardlight_inspect tool reads frontend source files (.html, .css, .js, .ts, .jsx, .tsx, .vue, .svelte and similar; at most 500 files and 8 MiB) under any local directory the model names, skipping hidden, symlinked, vendor/build and secret-named paths, and returns their design tokens and findings to the model; the plugin adds a short system-prompt section naming its tools to every session; the tools make no network calls, run no subprocesses and write no files; the optional hardlight browser command, run by hand from a shell, launches a locally installed Chromium against loopback or file:// pages only and writes its report to the output folder you give it.

name: health-data
description: Local health and daily-context data store for ViberVN Bot.

name: health-insights
description: Deterministic, local-first analysis of your own Apple Health data - weekly trends, rule-based concern checks, nutrition versus Dietary Reference Intakes, an IOM energy target, lab results and opt-in modules (GLP-1 monitoring, medication adherence; all off by default). Portable Agent Plugins v1 package of ten skills that drive the separately installed health-insights command line tool (installed from the plugin's own pinned copy); the plugin itself contains no executable. Works on a self-hosted HealthRelay or Health Bridge receiver database. Disclosure - it handles sensitive health data, so use a local model or one you trust; personal integrations (medication counts, model wording) are off by default. Disclosure — the skills run a separately installed health-insights CLI that reads your HealthRelay or Health Bridge SQLite database read-only and keeps imported lab and ECG results under ~/.local/share/health-insights; the health values it prints are sent to whichever model provider your ViberVN Bot session uses.

name: healthcare
description: Local-first personal health records: encrypted on-device Vault (AES-GCM) for vitals, medications, activities, emotions, sleep, encounters, diagnosis mentions, medication plans and reminders, served through a Keychain-paired local daemon with 24 scoped MCP tools. Zero-config first run: the plugin bootstraps Vault + daemon + agent pairing automatically under PLUGIN_DATA. Engine pinned to an immutable PyPI release (healthcare-mcp==0.2.1) over uvx stdio; Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), macOS only, Python 3.11+. Zero network by default; the optional LLM report-import endpoint stays off unless the user configures it. Approval-gated deletes, tamper-evident audit chain. Disclosure — personal health record-keeping, not medical advice (the skill forbids diagnoses and dosage changes); first run has uvx fetch healthcare-mcp==0.2.1 from PyPI; the optional report-import path posts report images to Alibaba DashScope (qwen-vl-max) unless HEALTHCARE_LLM_ENDPOINT points elsewhere, and only when HEALTHCARE_LLM_API_KEY is set.

name: healthrelay
description: Read-only access to your own Apple Health data through a self-hosted HealthRelay receiver. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package with one stdio MCP server (ten read-only tools, including intake evidence; no raw SQL, no write tools) and three skills for setup, review and troubleshooting. Requires your own HealthRelay receiver (health-bridge) and an iPhone app you sign yourself; the plugin ships neither. Disclosure — exposes your Apple Health data, read-only, from your own receiver database to whichever model you run, so use a local model or one you trust with health data; runs the separately installed health-bridge binary from PATH; the setup skill can install the receiver from the author's git tag with uv tool install.

name: heartbeat2
description: Your agent follows up on its own: timed check-ins, recurring checks and watchers that wake it in the same chat when something changes. You (with /pulse) or your agent (with the pulse tool) arm follow-ups at a time, recurring checks, a check-in after a long silence, or deterministic watchers on a file, process, URL, read-only command or ViberVN Bot event (kanban, subagent, API error, reactions). A wake is a turn in the same messaging DM that armed it, on that chat's own model: no side model, cron session or subagent. Watchers decide without a model call; the agent answers each wake with a structured verdict (notify or stay silent, never a typed sentinel); a no-op governor slows, then pauses pointless wakes and asks once. Every guardrail is a user setting (quiet hours, daily caps, unanswered mute, floors, lifetimes) that the agent works inside and can never widen. A one-time reminder you ask for in chat bypasses the unanswered mute and daily caps; HeartBeat 2.0 grants that only in a turn that carries your message. Arming returns a one-line receipt saying when the wake will really fire, and a wake that could never fire before it expires is refused. It delivers to messaging-gateway DMs only and needs plugins.entries.heartbeat2.allow_gateway_injection: true. Ships the plugin skill `heartbeat2:heartbeat2-report-problem`, which drafts a bug report and files it with the GitHub CLI only after the user approves the exact text. Disclosure — wakes and watchers run full turns on the conversation's own model, billed like any message, at your conversation's context size, with the conversation's normal tools and approval prompts; the agent can arm wakes and watchers itself unless you set agent_can_create to ask_first or no; command watchers run allowlisted read-only commands (default gh pr view/checks, gh run view/list, git ls-remote/status/log) without an approval prompt, with no shell, a sanitized environment (no provider keys, GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN) and the process group killed after 30 s, can use your stored git/gh credentials, and `git ls-remote <url>` / `gh -R` can contact any host your machine can reach; URL watchers make the GET requests you or the agent configured, without URL credentials, cookies, auth headers or proxies, always refuse cloud-metadata addresses and refuse private or local addresses unless url_allow_private is on; file watchers refuse paths ViberVN Bot blocks from reading; notes, summaries and event payloads are stored in plaintext in the profile's plugin-data; no telemetry.

name: hermetic
description: Status-bar popover for ViberVN Bot Desktop with three views: Costs (spend, cache, pricing drift, OpenRouter provider routing), AAI (skill changes, ratings, tests and replays) and HDR (a guard for risky tool calls, hooks, destinations, sensitive paths, what runs on its own). Disclosure — reads this profile's sessions (and other profiles' when you pick them) to audit tool calls, paths and hosts; can edit and save config.yaml and rewrite skill files when you ship or revert a version; AAI replays and judge runs resend conversation context and tool definitions to OpenRouter with your OpenRouter key and incur cost; HDR lists listening TCP ports via ps/lsof; HDR's guard (off by default) checks each tool call through a pre_tool_call hook and, when you turn it on, holds calls ViberVN Bot does not check itself (reading keys and logins, writing startup items or key places ViberVN Bot does not list) and asks you in its own card or a macOS notification, blocking after up to 20 seconds without an answer or at once when Hermetic is not open, or blocks them outright; the guard is a best-effort match on the paths a call names, not a sandbox; questions from every profile wait in the default profile's hermetic folder; HDR also lists shell and gateway hooks and flags hook scripts edited after approval, keeping a copy of each script to compare.

name: hicortex
description: Shared fleet memory for ViberVN Bot agents: every connected agent learns from all other agents connected to the memory, wherever they run. Sessions across machines and harnesses are distilled into one common brain overnight — what one learns, the whole fleet recalls. Pushes a compact per-turn recall index (entries lazy-load via hicortex_get), injects fresh lessons plus a per-agent standing context block at session start — lesson blocks are delimited and carry an explicit reference-data framing line and provenance header — and exposes the full 9-tool memory surface (search, get, recent, ingest, lessons, index, graph, update, delete) through the shared server. The same server also serves Claude Code, OpenClaw, Pi and opencode agents, so mixed-harness fleets share one brain. Stdlib-only, no pip dependencies. Requires a running Hicortex server (npx @gamaze/hicortex init on any machine); data flow: each user message is sent to your configured Hicortex server for recall (default http://localhost:8787); session distillation runs on the server. Disclosure — sends every user message (and profile name) to your configured Hicortex server each turn for recall, default http://localhost:8787, plain http with a bearer token is accepted for remote servers with a one-time log warning; the server's standing Identity text and lessons are injected into the system prompt; the model can permanently update or delete shared fleet memories via hicortex_update / hicortex_delete without confirmation.

name: hindsight
description: Hindsight long-term memory provider — knowledge graph, entity resolution and multi-strategy retrieval (recall/reflect/retain tools plus automatic per-turn capture). Maintained by Vectorize; cloud, local external and local embedded modes are available. `vibervnbot memory setup` fetches its bank-template catalog from raw.githubusercontent.com (vectorize-io/hindsight main). Disclosure — in cloud mode (and local external) every turn's conversation, and every entry the agent adds or replaces in ViberVN Bot's built-in MEMORY/USER stores, is sent to api.hindsight.vectorize.io or the URL you configure, into every bank it writes to; local embedded mode starts a background Hindsight daemon (fetched with uvx, version-pinned, on first run when hindsight-api is not installed) and keeps its LLM settings in ~/.hindsight/profiles/<profile>.env; setup writes the keys you enter to the profile .env; repositories under folders you list in trusted_project_dirs may choose their bank with .hindsight/config.toml; `vibervnbot memory setup` fetches its bank-template catalog from raw.githubusercontent.com (vectorize-io/hindsight main).

name: holographic
description: Local fact-store memory provider: SQLite with FTS5 keyword search (word forms in English, Russian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Indonesian, German, Hindi, Arabic, Bengali, Italian, Turkish, Polish and Dutch; Russian and English words of the same root at a lower weight, from bundled DerivBase.Ru (Apache-2.0) and Open English Wordnet (CC BY 4.0) pairs; German compounds and German and Spanish irregular verb forms from bundled Wikidata Lexemes tables (CC0); Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Thai by character n-grams, Chinese also split into words with jieba's dictionary (MIT), Traditional and Simplified Chinese compared as one through a bundled OpenCC table (Apache-2.0), Japanese spelling variants through SudachiDict's (Apache-2.0); synonyms through keywords the agent gives when it stores a fact), trust scores, entities with aliases and HRR (holographic reduced representation) recall, with no API key, network or model calls unless an optional online feature is switched on: search by meaning (embeddings: on) or rescoring by a cross-encoder (rerank: on), both off by default. The provider that shipped in-tree as plugins/memory/holographic, with the same provider name, config (plugins.vibervnbot-memory-store) and memory_store.db, so `vibervnbot update` moves existing users onto it; the schema change is additive and older versions keep working on the file. Maintained by itpartypattaya; since 0.1.1 it fixes probe/reason/related/contradict, non-atomic writes and the never-written retrieval_count, gates recall by relevance without repeats, flags duplicates and conflicts when a fact is added, and honours the provider contract (read-only subagent contexts, vibervnbot_home, mirror metadata, backup_paths); since 0.8.0 it keeps the history of every fact (change / end / correct / revert, search and list as_of a date) and `forget` erases a fact with all its versions from the file; since 0.16.0 a name guessed from a fact's text must be shaped like one and stays provisional until a second fact or a person confirms it, and entities can be renamed or deleted (the facts stay). Since 0.18.0 an optional, experimental second stage reorders the recall candidates with a cross-encoder at a /v1/rerank endpoint that answers in Cohere's shape without a key, such as llama-server (rerank: on, off by default). It does not raise hits: on the maintainer's held-out set (126 questions) it cut non-target facts in the top five by about 40 % and lines per turn by about a third, and lost about one target per hundred questions. Disclosure — local only unless an optional online feature (search by meaning or rescoring) is switched on: reads and writes one SQLite file per profile ($VIBERVNBOT_HOME/memory_store.db unless db_path says otherwise), or with scope: user / chat / thread one file per user or chat in holographic-users/ or holographic-chats/ next to it; each fact version records where it was written (platform, chat type, chat and thread id, session id, the turn author's id and display name, and whether the person said it or the agent inferred it; never chat titles), shown in full by list, history and export and not in recall unless recall_source: short (date, display name, this or another chat); each confirmation of a fact by a person keeps its time, session id and that person's id (no text); forget deletes that and the confirmations with the fact and keeps only an HMAC of the text, keyed by a random key stored in the same file, as a tombstone; delete_entity removes a name, its aliases and links from the entity index (never a fact) and keeps an HMAC of each name the same way (not of an alias only a fact's text gave, which goes without one), and both rewrite the file so freed pages keep no copy; the first writable open after an upgrade that changes the extraction rules relinks the facts to their entities under the new rules (stores up to 2,000 facts and 500,000 characters; larger ones on fact_store rebuild_entities), changing only the names it guessed and their links, never a fact, a declared name or an alias someone gave; subagents never write, but a cron job's explicit fact_store / fact_feedback calls do unless cron_writes: false (on by default); no subprocesses or telemetry (at the debug log level the recall stages log fact ids and scores, never text), and no network calls or credentials unless embeddings: on or rerank: on (both off by default).
